notes: Mid-market product analytics vendor building a consumer-facing personalization chat and support assistant. Trying Hosted API first to validate user flows, then wants committed Dedicated capacity for predictable latency and cost. Quote snippets from PM: "Need predictable sub-300ms P95 for chat on 95% of cases". PM cares about token mix, KV cache warmup, and fallback policies. SE notes: trial showed avg latency 180-250ms on short contexts, long-context (>1k tokens) few P95 spikes. Legal: wants explicit data residency options and audit log retention 3+ years. Finance: needs ARR bands and committed tier pricing to present to procurement. POC artifacts: call transcripts, trial metrics dashboard, token histogram. CRM style: fragments common, follow-ups required, multiple stakeholders (PM, infra lead, procurement).
capacity_sizing_notes: Hosted trial (sample week): avg QPS 3.8, 95th-percentile QPS 11.6, avg tokens/request 220 (prompt ~150, completion ~70). Token split ~68% prompt / 32% completion. Observed concurrency during peak test: ~18 concurrent streams (chat sessions) with bursts to 34. Ravenwood's forecast (12-month target): baseline QPS 25, peak QPS 120 (5-10 minute bursts), average tokens/request projected to increase to 260 as features expand. Projected monthly token volume ~1.8B tokens. Recommended Dedicated starting point: 2 x 80GB GPU nodes with autoscale policy to add 2 nodes at sustained 80% util; pre-warm KV cache for frequent prefixes. Alternative config: 4 x 40GB nodes to improve concurrency with cost trade-offs. Ask Redwood: provide expected P95 numbers and cost per 1M tokens for each dedicated tier plus canary/fallback latency SLOs.
procurement_notes: Procurement requires 60-day legal review window. Finance requests 3 pricing scenarios: pilot (no commit), 12-month commit, 24-month commit with volume discount. Evaluate potential need for reserved burst capacity.
sales_playbook_tips: Lead with observed trial metrics and concrete capacity plan. Emphasize cache warmup strategy and autoscale cost controls. Provide clear mapping: forecast QPS -> node counts -> estimated monthly cost. Include tumble charts for token mix sensitivity.
assumptions_logged: Forecast assumes 30% growth MoM for first 3 months post-launch, then 10% MoM. Peak bursts assumed 4x baseline for marketing events. Token growth tied to richer prompts from personalization context.
